text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r-b-i-d s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r and p-r-e-a-g-r-e-e-d t-e-n-d-e-r f-o-r-m-s, leaving a m-o-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d of s-i-m-u-l-t-a-n-e-o-u-s f-i-l-i-n-g-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t b-i-d d-r-a-f-t-i-n-g r-u-l-e was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a w-i-t-h t-w-o c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d u-n-t-r-a-c-e-d c-h-a-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s and a c-o-m-m-o-n s-p-r-e-e-d-s-h-e-e-t, leaving a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a l-o-g of s-h-a-r-e-d f-i-l-e l-i-n-k-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n b-a-r-r-i-e-r p-o-l-i-c-y was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the actor s-e-t u-p h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d o-f-f-b-o-o-k p-a-y-m-e-n-t a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and f-a-l-s-e i-n-v-o-i-c-e l-i-n-e i-t-e-m-s, leaving a t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n l-e-d-g-e r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e in the a-p p r o v-a-l f-l-o-w as the t-r-a-c-e, and the d-u-a-l a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l f-o-r p-a-r-t-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the actor r-o-t-a-t-e-d w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r s-l-o-t-s, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a p-r-e-a-g-r-e-e-d o-r-d-e-r l-i-s-t and s-y-n-c-r-o-n-i-z-e-d r-e-v-i-s-i-o-n n-o-t-e-s, leaving a v-e-r-s-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y showing i-d-e-n-t-i-c-a-l r-a-t-e c-a-r-d-s across r-o-u-n-d-s as the t-r-a-c-e, and the a-n-o-m-a-l-y s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g of w-i-n-r-a-t-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the actor d-r-e-s-s e-d the r-e-c-o-r-d to l-o-o-k c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e, which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a c-l-e-a-n-s-e-d c-o-r-r-e-s-p-o-n-d-e-n-c-e t-h-r-e-a-d and a r-e-d-a-c-t-e-d m-e-e-t-i-n-g m-i-n-u-t-e, leaving a g-a-p in the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l where o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s w-e-r-e r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d as the t-r-a-c-e, and the r-e-c-o-r-d r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n a-n-d a-l-t-e-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l that was b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
